title: Sustainability reporting deserves better software.
intro: Aeiforo is the company. Nexus is the platform. We were started by a small group of sustainability practitioners and engineers who got tired of stitching together five spreadsheets and four point-tools for every reporting cycle. So we built one system that does the whole job — and we keep it honest.

mission.statement: Make every sustainability disclosure as trustworthy and as effortless as a bank statement.

sustainability.title: Sustainability first
sustainability.body: We build software for the people doing the hardest work in climate. Our priorities follow theirs.

auditable.title: Auditable by default
auditable.body: Every number has a source. Every change has a trail. We never ask you to take our word for it.

open.title: Open about trade-offs
open.body: No oversold features, no marketecture. If it is a roadmap item, we say so.

calm.title: Calm software
calm.body: No dark patterns. No surprise upsells. The product gets out of your way so you can do the work.

cta.heading: Want to know more about what we're building?
